MANUAL_PAIRS = [
    # (timeline article link fragment OR name keywords, incident name keywords or href fragment)

]


def slug_from_url(url: str) -&gt; str:
    if not url:
        return &#34;&#34;
    path = url.split(&#34;?&#34;)[0].rstrip(&#34;/&#34;)
    return path.rsplit(&#34;/&#34;, 1)[-1].lower()


def normalize_text(s: str) -&gt; str:
    s = unicodedata.normalize(&#34;NFKD&#34;, s or &#34;&#34;)
    s = &#34;&#34;.join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    s = s.lower()
    s = s.replace(&#34;ʻ&#34;, &#34;&#34;).replace(&#34;&#39;&#34;, &#34;&#34;).replace(&#34;&#39;&#34;, &#34;&#34;).replace(&#34;&#34;&#34;, &#34;&#34;).replace(&#34;&#34;&#34;, &#34;&#34;)
    s = re.sub(r&#34;[^a-z0-9]+&#34;, &#34; &#34;, s)
    stop = {
        &#34;the&#34;, &#34;a&#34;, &#34;an&#34;, &#34;of&#34;, &#34;and&#34;, &#34;or&#34;, &#34;ufo&#34;, &#34;ufos&#34;, &#34;uap&#34;, &#34;uaps&#34;, &#34;incident&#34;,
        &#34;sighting&#34;, &#34;sightings&#34;, &#34;video&#34;, &#34;videos&#34;, &#34;photo&#34;, &#34;photos&#34;, &#34;photographs&#34;,
        &#34;over&#34;, &#34;in&#34;, &#34;on&#34;, &#34;at&#34;, &#34;to&#34;, &#34;for&#34;, &#34;with&#34;, &#34;by&#34;, &#34;from&#34;, &#34;seen&#34;, &#34;witnessed&#34;,
        &#34;case&#34;, &#34;report&#34;, &#34;school&#34;, &#34;mass&#34;,
    }
    tokens = [t for t in s.split() if t and t not in stop]
    return &#34; &#34;.join(tokens)


def years_in(s: str) -&gt; set[int]:
    return {int(y) for y in re.findall(r&#34;\b(18\d{2}|19\d{2}|20\d{2})\b&#34;, s or &#34;&#34;)}


def parse_tsv(text: str) -&gt; list[dict]:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(text.strip().splitlines(), delimiter=&#34;\t&#34;))
    return rows


def parse_incidents(path: Path) -&gt; list[dict]:
    text = path.read_text(encoding=&#34;utf-8&#34;)
    return list(csv.DictReader(text.strip().splitlines(), delimiter=&#34;\t&#34;))


timeline = parse_tsv(TIMELINE_TSV)
incidents = parse_incidents(INCIDENTS_PATH)

print(f&#34;timeline rows: {len(timeline)}&#34;)
print(f&#34;incident rows: {len(incidents)}&#34;)

# Index incidents
inc_by_slug = {}
for i, row in enumerate(incidents):
    href = row.get(&#34;photo href&#34;) or &#34;&#34;
    slug = slug_from_url(href)
    inc_by_slug[slug] = i
    row[&#34;_slug&#34;] = slug
    row[&#34;_norm&#34;] = normalize_text(row.get(&#34;name&#34;, &#34;&#34;))
    row[&#34;_years&#34;] = years_in(row.get(&#34;date&#34;, &#34;&#34;) + &#34; &#34; + row.get(&#34;name&#34;, &#34;&#34;))

for t in timeline:
    link = t.get(&#34;article link&#34;) or &#34;&#34;
    t[&#34;_slug&#34;] = slug_from_url(link)
    t[&#34;_norm&#34;] = normalize_text(t.get(&#34;name&#34;, &#34;&#34;))
    t[&#34;_years&#34;] = years_in(t.get(&#34;date&#34;, &#34;&#34;) + &#34; &#34; + t.get(&#34;name&#34;, &#34;&#34;))

# Build match map: timeline_idx -&gt; incident_idx
matched_inc = set()
pairs: list[tuple[int, int, str, float]] = []

# 1) Manual pairs via slug containment
for t_frag, i_frag in MANUAL_PAIRS:
    t_idx = next((i for i, t in enumerate(timeline) if t_frag in (t.get(&#34;_slug&#34;) or &#34;&#34;) or t_frag in (t.get(&#34;article link&#34;) or &#34;&#34;)), None)
    i_idx = next((i for i, r in enumerate(incidents) if i_frag in (r.get(&#34;_slug&#34;) or &#34;&#34;) or i_frag in (r.get(&#34;photo href&#34;) or &#34;&#34;)), None)
    if t_idx is not None and i_idx is not None and i_idx not in matched_inc:
        pairs.append((t_idx, i_idx, &#34;manual&#34;, 1.0))
        matched_inc.add(i_idx)

# 2) Exact slug match (timeline slug vs incident slug)
for ti, t in enumerate(timeline):
    if any(p[0] == ti for p in pairs):
        continue
    slug = t[&#34;_slug&#34;]
    if slug and slug in inc_by_slug:
        ii = inc_by_slug[slug]
        if ii not in matched_inc:
            pairs.append((ti, ii, &#34;slug&#34;, 1.0))
            matched_inc.add(ii)

# 3) Fuzzy name + overlapping year
for ti, t in enumerate(timeline):
    if any(p[0] == ti for p in pairs):
        continue
    best = None
    for ii, inc in enumerate(incidents):
        if ii in matched_inc:
            continue
        # year gate: if both have years, require overlap OR adjacent (Carter date quirks)
        if t[&#34;_years&#34;] and inc[&#34;_years&#34;]:
            overlap = t[&#34;_years&#34;] &amp; inc[&#34;_years&#34;]
            near = any(abs(a - b) &lt;= 4 for a in t[&#34;_years&#34;] for b in inc[&#34;_years&#34;])
            if not overlap and not near:
                continue
        ratio = SequenceMatcher(None, t[&#34;_norm&#34;], inc[&#34;_norm&#34;]).ratio()
        # token Jaccard
        ta, tb = set(t[&#34;_norm&#34;].split()), set(inc[&#34;_norm&#34;].split())
        jacc = (len(ta &amp; tb) / len(ta | tb)) if ta and tb else 0.0
        score = max(ratio, jacc)
        # bonus for shared distinctive tokens length&gt;=5
        shared = {x for x in (ta &amp; tb) if len(x) &gt;= 5}
        score += 0.08 * min(len(shared), 3)
        if best is None or score &gt; best[0]:
            best = (score, ii, ratio, jacc)
    if best and best[0] &gt;= 0.55:
        pairs.append((ti, best[1], &#34;fuzzy&#34;, round(best[0], 3)))
        matched_inc.add(best[1])

pair_by_t = {t: (i, how, sc) for t, i, how, sc in pairs}
pair_by_i = {i: (t, how, sc) for t, i, how, sc in pairs}

        &#34;match_method&#34;: None,

        &#34;slug_incident&#34;: None,
    }
    if ti in pair_by_t:
        ii, how, sc = pair_by_t[ti]
        inc = incidents[ii]
        rec[&#34;sources&#34;] = [&#34;timeline&#34;, &#34;incident&#34;]
        rec[&#34;match_method&#34;] = how
        rec[&#34;match_score&#34;] = sc
        rec[&#34;incident_url&#34;] = (inc.get(&#34;photo href&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip()
        rec[&#34;photo_src_incident&#34;] = (inc.get(&#34;photo src&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip()
        rec[&#34;description_incident&#34;] = (inc.get(&#34;description&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip()
        rec[&#34;slug_incident&#34;] = inc.get(&#34;_slug&#34;)
        # Prefer longer / incident-page name when timeline title is editorial
        inc_name = (inc.get(&#34;name&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip()
        if inc_name and len(inc_name) &gt;= 3:
            rec[&#34;aliases&#34;] = list({rec[&#34;canonical_name&#34;], inc_name})
            # Prefer incident name when it&#39;s the established case name
            if how in (&#34;manual&#34;, &#34;slug&#34;) or sc &gt;= 0.7:
                # keep timeline name as display if it has claim-style framing; store both
                pass
        # Prefer more specific date when both exist
        inc_date = (inc.get(&#34;date&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip()
        if inc_date and (not rec[&#34;date&#34;] or len(inc_date) &gt; len(rec[&#34;date&#34;])):
            rec[&#34;date_incident&#34;] = inc_date
            if how in (&#34;manual&#34;, &#34;slug&#34;):
                # keep timeline date as primary chronological label; also store incident date
                pass
        else:
            rec[&#34;date_incident&#34;] = inc_date
    else:
        rec[&#34;aliases&#34;] = [rec[&#34;canonical_name&#34;]]
        rec[&#34;date_incident&#34;] = &#34;&#34;
    if &#34;aliases&#34; not in rec:
        rec[&#34;aliases&#34;] = [rec[&#34;canonical_name&#34;]]
    # Prefer best photo: incident gallery over timeline if present; skip not-found
    photo = rec[&#34;photo_src_incident&#34;] or rec[&#34;photo_src_timeline&#34;]
    if &#34;not-found&#34; in (photo or &#34;&#34;):
        photo = rec[&#34;photo_src_incident&#34;] if &#34;not-found&#34; not in (rec[&#34;photo_src_incident&#34;] or &#34;&#34;) else rec[&#34;photo_src_timeline&#34;]
        if &#34;not-found&#34; in (photo or &#34;&#34;):
            photo = &#34;&#34;
    rec[&#34;photo_src&#34;] = photo
    # Unified description: prefer longer incident description when matched, else timeline
    desc = rec[&#34;description_incident&#34;] or rec[&#34;description_timeline&#34;]
    if rec[&#34;description_incident&#34;] and rec[&#34;description_timeline&#34;]:
        # pick longer
        desc = max(rec[&#34;description_incident&#34;], rec[&#34;description_timeline&#34;], key=len)
    rec[&#34;description&#34;] = desc
    rec[&#34;primary_url&#34;] = rec[&#34;incident_url&#34;] or rec[&#34;timeline_url&#34;]
    merged.append(rec)

# Add unmatched incidents
for ii, inc in enumerate(incidents):
    if ii in matched_inc:
        continue
    photo = (inc.get(&#34;photo src&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip()
    if &#34;not-found&#34; in photo:
        photo = &#34;&#34;
    merged.append({
        &#34;canonical_name&#34;: (inc.get(&#34;name&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip(),
        &#34;date&#34;: (inc.get(&#34;date&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip(),
        &#34;date_incident&#34;: (inc.get(&#34;date&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip(),
        &#34;claim&#34;: &#34;&#34;,
        &#34;description_timeline&#34;: &#34;&#34;,
        &#34;description_incident&#34;: (inc.get(&#34;description&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip(),
        &#34;description&#34;: (inc.get(&#34;description&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip(),
        &#34;photo_src_timeline&#34;: &#34;&#34;,
        &#34;photo_src_incident&#34;: photo,
        &#34;photo_src&#34;: photo,
        &#34;timeline_url&#34;: &#34;&#34;,
        &#34;incident_url&#34;: (inc.get(&#34;photo href&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip(),
        &#34;primary_url&#34;: (inc.get(&#34;photo href&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip(),
        &#34;sources&#34;: [&#34;incident&#34;],
        &#34;match_method&#34;: None,
        &#34;match_score&#34;: None,
        &#34;slug_timeline&#34;: None,
        &#34;slug_incident&#34;: inc.get(&#34;_slug&#34;),
        &#34;aliases&#34;: [(inc.get(&#34;name&#34;) or &#34;&#34;).strip()],
    })

# Sort by crude year then name
def sort_key(r):
    years = years_in(r.get(&#34;date&#34;, &#34;&#34;)) or years_in(r.get(&#34;date_incident&#34;, &#34;&#34;))
    y = min(years) if years else 9999
    return (y, r.get(&#34;canonical_name&#34;, &#34;&#34;).lower())

merged.sort(key=sort_key)

# Stats
both = sum(1 for r in merged if set(r[&#34;sources&#34;]) == {&#34;timeline&#34;, &#34;incident&#34;})
only_t = sum(1 for r in merged if r[&#34;sources&#34;] == [&#34;timeline&#34;])
only_i = sum(1 for r in merged if r[&#34;sources&#34;] == [&#34;incident&#34;])

print(f&#34;merged rows: {len(merged)}&#34;)
print(f&#34;both sources: {both}&#34;)
print(f&#34;timeline-only: {only_t}&#34;)
print(f&#34;incident-only: {only_i}&#34;)
print(&#34;\nMatched pairs:&#34;)
for ti, ii, how, sc in sorted(pairs, key=lambda x: x[0]):
    print(f&#34;  [{how} {sc}] {timeline[ti][&#39;name&#39;][:50]!r}  &lt;-&gt;  {incidents[ii][&#39;name&#39;][:50]!r}&#34;)

# Write JSON
out_json = ROOT / &#34;merged-catalog.json&#34;
out_json.write_text(json.dumps({
    &#34;meta&#34;: {
        &#34;source&#34;: &#34;theufodatabase.com&#34;,
        &#34;timeline_count&#34;: len(timeline),
        &#34;incident_count&#34;: len(incidents),
        &#34;merged_count&#34;: len(merged),
        &#34;matched_both&#34;: both,
        &#34;timeline_only&#34;: only_t,
        &#34;incident_only&#34;: only_i,
        &#34;created&#34;: &#34;2026-08-08&#34;,
    },
    &#34;records&#34;: merged,
}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding=&#34;utf-8&#34;)

# Write TSV flat
out_tsv = ROOT / &#34;merged-catalog.tsv&#34;
fields = [
    &#34;date&#34;, &#34;date_incident&#34;, &#34;canonical_name&#34;, &#34;aliases&#34;, &#34;claim&#34;, &#34;description&#34;,
    &#34;photo_src&#34;, &#34;timeline_url&#34;, &#34;incident_url&#34;, &#34;primary_url&#34;, &#34;sources&#34;,
    &#34;match_method&#34;, &#34;match_score&#34;,
]
with out_tsv.open(&#34;w&#34;, encoding=&#34;utf-8&#34;, newline=&#34;&#34;) as f:
    w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fields, delimiter=&#34;\t&#34;, extrasaction=&#34;ignore&#34;)
    w.writeheader()
    for r in merged:
        row = dict(r)
        row[&#34;aliases&#34;] = &#34; | &#34;.join(row.get(&#34;aliases&#34;) or [])
        row[&#34;sources&#34;] = &#34;+&#34;.join(row.get(&#34;sources&#34;) or [])
        w.writerow(row)

# Also copy raw inputs for provenance
(ROOT / &#34;timeline-source.tsv&#34;).write_text(TIMELINE_TSV, encoding=&#34;utf-8&#34;)
(ROOT / &#34;incidents-source.tsv&#34;).write_text(INCIDENTS_PATH.read_text(encoding=&#34;utf-8&#34;), encoding=&#34;utf-8&#34;)

print(f&#34;\nWrote {out_json}&#34;)
print(f&#34;Wrote {out_tsv}&#34;)

```bash
]


def slug_from_url(url: str) -> str:
    if not url:
        return ""
    path = url.split("?")[0].rstrip("/")
    return path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1].lower()


def normalize_text(s: str) -> str:
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", s or "")
    s = "".join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    s = s.lower()
    s = s.replace("ʻ", "").replace("'", "").replace("'", "").replace(""", "").replace(""", "")
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", s)
    stop = {
        "the", "a", "an", "of", "and", "or", "ufo", "ufos", "uap", "uaps", "incident",
        "sighting", "sightings", "video", "videos", "photo", "photos", "photographs",
        "over", "in", "on", "at", "to", "for", "with", "by", "from", "seen", "witnessed",
        "case", "report", "school", "mass",
    }
    tokens = [t for t in s.split() if t and t not in stop]
    return " ".join(tokens)


def years_in(s: str) -> set[int]:
    return {int(y) for y in re.findall(r"\b(18\d{2}|19\d{2}|20\d{2})\b", s or "")}


def parse_tsv(text: str) -> list[dict]:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(text.strip().splitlines(), delimiter="\t"))
    return rows


def parse_incidents(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    return list(csv.DictReader(text.strip().splitlines(), delimiter="\t"))


timeline = parse_tsv(TIMELINE_TSV)
incidents = parse_incidents(INCIDENTS_PATH)

print(f"timeline rows: {len(timeline)}")
print(f"incident rows: {len(incidents)}")

# Index incidents
inc_by_slug = {}
for i, row in enumerate(incidents):
    href = row.get("photo href") or ""
    slug = slug_from_url(href)
    inc_by_slug[slug] = i
    row["_slug"] = slug
    row["_norm"] = normalize_text(row.get("name", ""))
    row["_years"] = years_in(row.get("date", "") + " " + row.get("name", ""))

for t in timeline:
    link = t.get("article link") or ""
    t["_slug"] = slug_from_url(link)
    t["_norm"] = normalize_text(t.get("name", ""))
    t["_years"] = years_in(t.get("date", "") + " " + t.get("name", ""))

# Build match map: timeline_idx -> incident_idx
matched_inc = set()
pairs: list[tuple[int, int, str, float]] = []

# 1) Manual pairs via slug containment
for t_frag, i_frag in MANUAL_PAIRS:
    t_idx = next((i for i, t in enumerate(timeline) if t_frag in (t.get("_slug") or "") or t_frag in (t.get("article link") or "")), None)
    i_idx = next((i for i, r in enumerate(incidents) if i_frag in (r.get("_slug") or "") or i_frag in (r.get("photo href") or "")), None)
    if t_idx is not None and i_idx is not None and i_idx not in matched_inc:
        pairs.append((t_idx, i_idx, "manual", 1.0))
        matched_inc.add(i_idx)

# 2) Exact slug match (timeline slug vs incident slug)
for ti, t in enumerate(timeline):
    if any(p[0] == ti for p in pairs):
        continue
    slug = t["_slug"]
    if slug and slug in inc_by_slug:
        ii = inc_by_slug[slug]
        if ii not in matched_inc:
            pairs.append((ti, ii, "slug", 1.0))
            matched_inc.add(ii)

# 3) Fuzzy name + overlapping year
for ti, t in enumerate(timeline):
    if any(p[0] == ti for p in pairs):
        continue
    best = None
    for ii, inc in enumerate(incidents):
        if ii in matched_inc:
            continue
        # year gate: if both have years, require overlap OR adjacent (Carter date quirks)
        if t["_years"] and inc["_years"]:
            overlap = t["_years"] & inc["_years"]
            near = any(abs(a - b) <= 4 for a in t["_years"] for b in inc["_years"])
            if not overlap and not near:
                continue
        ratio = SequenceMatcher(None, t["_norm"], inc["_norm"]).ratio()
        # token Jaccard
        ta, tb = set(t["_norm"].split()), set(inc["_norm"].split())
        jacc = (len(ta & tb) / len(ta | tb)) if ta and tb else 0.0
        score = max(ratio, jacc)
        # bonus for shared distinctive tokens length>=5
        shared = {x for x in (ta & tb) if len(x) >= 5}
        score += 0.08 * min(len(shared), 3)
        if best is None or score > best[0]:
            best = (score, ii, ratio, jacc)
    if best and best[0] >= 0.55:
        pairs.append((ti, best[1], "fuzzy", round(best[0], 3)))
        matched_inc.add(best[1])

pair_by_t = {t: (i, how, sc) for t, i, how, sc in pairs}
pair_by_i = {i: (t, how, sc) for t, i, how, sc in pairs}

merged = []
for ti, t in enumerate(timeline):
    rec = {
        "canonical_name": t.get("name", "").strip(),
        "date": t.get("date", "").strip(),
        "claim": t.get("claim", "").strip(),
        "description_timeline": t.get("description", "").strip(),
        "description_incident": "",
        "photo_src_timeline": t.get("photo src", "").strip(),
        "photo_src_incident": "",
        "timeline_url": t.get("article link", "").strip(),
        "incident_url": "",
        "sources": ["timeline"],
        "match_method": None,
        "match_score": None,
        "slug_timeline": t.get("_slug"),
        "slug_incident": None,
    }
    if ti in pair_by_t:
        ii, how, sc = pair_by_t[ti]
        inc = incidents[ii]
        rec["sources"] = ["timeline", "incident"]
        rec["match_method"] = how
        rec["match_score"] = sc
        rec["incident_url"] = (inc.get("photo href") or "").strip()
        rec["photo_src_incident"] = (inc.get("photo src") or "").strip()
        rec["description_incident"] = (inc.get("description") or "").strip()
        rec["slug_incident"] = inc.get("_slug")
        # Prefer longer / incident-page name when timeline title is editorial
        inc_name = (inc.get("name") or "").strip()
        if inc_name and len(inc_name) >= 3:
            rec["aliases"] = list({rec["canonical_name"], inc_name})
            # Prefer incident name when it's the established case name
            if how in ("manual", "slug") or sc >= 0.7:
                # keep timeline name as display if it has claim-style framing; store both
                pass
        # Prefer more specific date when both exist
        inc_date = (inc.get("date") or "").strip()
        if inc_date and (not rec["date"] or len(inc_date) > len(rec["date"])):
            rec["date_incident"] = inc_date
            if how in ("manual", "slug"):
                # keep timeline date as primary chronological label; also store incident date
                pass
        else:
            rec["date_incident"] = inc_date
    else:
        rec["aliases"] = [rec["canonical_name"]]
        rec["date_incident"] = ""
    if "aliases" not in rec:
        rec["aliases"] = [rec["canonical_name"]]
    # Prefer best photo: incident gallery over timeline if present; skip not-found
    photo = rec["photo_src_incident"] or rec["photo_src_timeline"]
    if "not-found" in (photo or ""):
        photo = rec["photo_src_incident"] if "not-found" not in (rec["photo_src_incident"] or "") else rec["photo_src_timeline"]
        if "not-found" in (photo or ""):
            photo = ""
    rec["photo_src"] = photo
    # Unified description: prefer longer incident description when matched, else timeline
    desc = rec["description_incident"] or rec["description_timeline"]
    if rec["description_incident"] and rec["description_timeline"]:
        # pick longer
        desc = max(rec["description_incident"], rec["description_timeline"], key=len)
    rec["description"] = desc
    rec["primary_url"] = rec["incident_url"] or rec["timeline_url"]
    merged.append(rec)

# Add unmatched incidents
for ii, inc in enumerate(incidents):
    if ii in matched_inc:
        continue
    photo = (inc.get("photo src") or "").strip()
    if "not-found" in photo:
        photo = ""
    merged.append({
        "canonical_name": (inc.get("name") or "").strip(),
        "date": (inc.get("date") or "").strip(),
        "date_incident": (inc.get("date") or "").strip(),
        "claim": "",
        "description_timeline": "",
        "description_incident": (inc.get("description") or "").strip(),
        "description": (inc.get("description") or "").strip(),
        "photo_src_timeline": "",
        "photo_src_incident": photo,
        "photo_src": photo,
        "timeline_url": "",
        "incident_url": (inc.get("photo href") or "").strip(),
        "primary_url": (inc.get("photo href") or "").strip(),
        "sources": ["incident"],
        "match_method": None,
        "match_score": None,
        "slug_timeline": None,
        "slug_incident": inc.get("_slug"),
        "aliases": [(inc.get("name") or "").strip()],
    })

# Sort by crude year then name
def sort_key(r):
    years = years_in(r.get("date", "")) or years_in(r.get("date_incident", ""))
    y = min(years) if years else 9999
    return (y, r.get("canonical_name", "").lower())

merged.sort(key=sort_key)

# Stats
both = sum(1 for r in merged if set(r["sources"]) == {"timeline", "incident"})
only_t = sum(1 for r in merged if r["sources"] == ["timeline"])
only_i = sum(1 for r in merged if r["sources"] == ["incident"])

print(f"merged rows: {len(merged)}")
print(f"both sources: {both}")
print(f"timeline-only: {only_t}")
print(f"incident-only: {only_i}")
print("\nMatched pairs:")
for ti, ii, how, sc in sorted(pairs, key=lambda x: x[0]):
    print(f"  [{how} {sc}] {timeline[ti]['name'][:50]!r}  <->  {incidents[ii]['name'][:50]!r}")

# Write JSON
out_json = ROOT / "merged-catalog.json"
out_json.write_text(json.dumps({
    "meta": {
        "source": "theufodatabase.com",
        "timeline_count": len(timeline),
        "incident_count": len(incidents),
        "merged_count": len(merged),
        "matched_both": both,
        "timeline_only": only_t,
        "incident_only": only_i,
        "created": "2026-08-08",
    },
    "records": merged,
}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")

# Write TSV flat
out_tsv = ROOT / "merged-catalog.tsv"
fields = [
    "date", "date_incident", "canonical_name", "aliases", "claim", "description",
    "photo_src", "timeline_url", "incident_url", "primary_url", "sources",
    "match_method", "match_score",
]
with out_tsv.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
```

```bash
cd packages/db && bun -e '
import { config } from "dotenv"
import { resolve } from "path"
import { writeFileSync } from "fs"
config({ path: resolve(process.cwd(), ".env") })
const { neon } = await import("@neondatabase/serverless")
const sql = neon(process.env.DATABASE_URL)
const rows = await sql`
  SELECT id, name, title, summary, description, location, latitude, longitude,
         date::text AS date, photos, category, metadata
  FROM events
  ORDER BY date ASC NULLS LAST, coalesce(name, title, id)
`
const out = resolve(process.cwd(), "../../.scratch/ufo-database-merge/neon-events.json")
writeFileSync(out, JSON.stringify({ count: rows.length, pulled_at: new Date().toISOString(), records: rows }, null, 2))
console.log("wrote", out, "rows", rows.length)
console.log("sample names:")
```

import json, re, unicodedata, csv

from pathlib import Path

    &#39;from&#39;,&#39;seen&#39;,&#39;witnessed&#39;,&#39;case&#39;,&#39;report&#39;,&#39;school&#39;,&#39;mass&#39;,&#39;event&#39;,&#39;phenomenon&#39;,&#39;celestial&#39;,
}

def normalize(s: str) -&gt; str:
    s = unicodedata.normalize(&#39;NFKD&#39;, s or &#39;&#39;)
    s = &#39;&#39;.join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    s = s.lower().replace(&#39;ʻ&#39;,&#39;&#39;).replace(&#34;&#39;&#34;,&#39;&#39;).replace(&#39;&#34;&#39;,&#39;&#39;)
    s = re.sub(r&#39;[^a-z0-9]+&#39;, &#39; &#39;, s)
    tokens = [t for t in s.split() if t and t not in STOP and len(t) &gt; 1]
    return &#39; &#39;.join(tokens)

def years(s: str) -&gt; set[int]:
    ys = set()
    for y in re.findall(r&#39;\b(\d{3,4})\b&#39;, s or &#39;&#39;):
        yi = int(y)
        if 100 &lt;= yi &lt;= 2100:
            ys.add(yi)
    return ys

def neon_label(r):
    return (r.get(&#39;name&#39;) or r.get(&#39;title&#39;) or &#39;&#39;).strip()

def neon_date_str(r):

    return d[:10] if d else &#39;&#39;

def neon_year(r):
    d = neon_date_str(r)
    if d and d[:4].isdigit():

for i, e in enumerate(neon):

    e[&#39;_years&#39;] = years(label) | ({e[&#39;_year&#39;]} if e[&#39;_year&#39;] else set())

matches = []  # list of dicts
used_neon = set()

# Strong keyword aliases for famous cases

    ([&#39;roswell&#39;], [&#39;roswell&#39;]),
    ([&#39;kenneth arnold&#39;, &#39;arnold&#39;], [&#39;kenneth arnold&#39;, &#39;arnold&#39;]),
    ([&#39;battle los angeles&#39;, &#39;battle la&#39;], [&#39;battle los angeles&#39;, &#39;los angeles&#39;]),
    ([&#39;phoenix&#39;], [&#39;phoenix&#39;]),
    ([&#39;nimitz&#39;, &#39;tic tac&#39;, &#39;tic-tac&#39;], [&#39;nimitz&#39;, &#39;tic tac&#39;, &#39;fravor&#39;]),
    ([&#39;mcminnville&#39;, &#39;trent&#39;], [&#39;mcminnville&#39;, &#39;trent&#39;]),
    ([&#39;rendlesham&#39;], [&#39;rendlesham&#39;]),
    ([&#39;ariel&#39;, &#39;ruwa&#39;, &#39;zimbabwe&#39;], [&#39;ariel&#39;, &#39;ruwa&#39;, &#39;zimbabwe&#39;]),
    ([&#39;westall&#39;], [&#39;westall&#39;]),
    ([&#39;varginha&#39;], [&#39;varginha&#39;]),
    ([&#39;foo fighter&#39;], [&#39;foo fighter&#39;]),
    ([&#39;ghost rocket&#39;], [&#39;ghost rocket&#39;]),
    ([&#39;oumuamua&#39;, &#39;omuamua&#39;], [&#39;oumuamua&#39;, &#39;omuamua&#39;]),
    ([&#39;ohare&#39;, &#34;o hare&#34;], [&#39;ohare&#39;, &#34;o hare&#34;]),
    ([&#39;socorro&#39;, &#39;zamora&#39;], [&#39;socorro&#39;, &#39;zamora&#39;]),
    ([&#39;belgium&#39;, &#39;belgian&#39;], [&#39;belgium&#39;, &#39;belgian&#39;]),
    ([&#39;mainbrace&#39;], [&#39;mainbrace&#39;]),
    ([&#39;washington&#39;], [&#39;washington&#39;]),
    ([&#39;carter&#39;], [&#39;carter&#39;]),
    ([&#39;reagan&#39;], [&#39;reagan&#39;]),
    ([&#39;trinity&#39;], [&#39;trinity&#39;]),
    ([&#39;mantell&#39;], [&#39;mantell&#39;]),
    ([&#39;malmstrom&#39;], [&#39;malmstrom&#39;]),
    ([&#39;area 51&#39;], [&#39;area 51&#39;]),
    ([&#39;blue book&#39;], [&#39;blue book&#39;]),
    ([&#39;project sign&#39;], [&#39;project sign&#39;, &#39;sign&#39;]),
    ([&#39;project grudge&#39;], [&#39;project grudge&#39;, &#39;grudge&#39;]),
    ([&#39;sputnik&#39;], [&#39;sputnik&#39;]),
    ([&#39;condon&#39;], [&#39;condon&#39;]),
    ([&#39;robertson panel&#39;], [&#39;robertson&#39;]),
    ([&#39;aatip&#39;], [&#39;aatip&#39;]),
    ([&#39;gimbal&#39;, &#39;gofast&#39;, &#39;go fast&#39;], [&#39;gimbal&#39;, &#39;gofast&#39;, &#39;go fast&#39;, &#39;theodore roosevelt&#39;]),
    ([&#39;florence&#39;, &#39;fiorentina&#39;], [&#39;florence&#39;, &#39;italy&#39;, &#39;fiorentina&#39;]),
    ([&#39;war worlds&#39;, &#39;orson welles&#39;], [&#39;war worlds&#39;, &#39;orson&#39;, &#39;welles&#39;]),
]

def alias_hit(cat_text, neon_text, pair):
    a, b = pair
    return any(x in cat_text for x in a) and any(x in neon_text for x in b)

for c in catalog:
    cat_blob = &#39; &#39;.join(c[&#39;_norms&#39;])
    best = None
    for e in neon:
        if e[&#39;_idx&#39;] in used_neon:
            continue
        # year gate when both have years
        if c[&#39;_years&#39;] and e[&#39;_years&#39;]:
            overlap = c[&#39;_years&#39;] &amp; e[&#39;_years&#39;]
            near = any(abs(a-b) &lt;= 5 for a in c[&#39;_years&#39;] for b in e[&#39;_years&#39;])
            if not overlap and not near:
                # still allow strong alias hits across date noise
                if not any(alias_hit(cat_blob, e[&#39;_norm&#39;], p) for p in ALIASES):
                    continue
        scores = [SequenceMatcher(None, n, e[&#39;_norm&#39;]).ratio() for n in c[&#39;_norms&#39;] if n]
        ta = set(cat_blob.split()); tb = set(e[&#39;_norm&#39;].split())
        jacc = len(ta &amp; tb)/len(ta|tb) if ta and tb else 0
        score = max(scores + [0] + [jacc])
        shared = {x for x in (ta &amp; tb) if len(x) &gt;= 4}
        score += 0.1 * min(len(shared), 3)
        # alias boost
        if any(alias_hit(cat_blob, e[&#39;_norm&#39;], p) for p in ALIASES):
            score += 0.35
        if best is None or score &gt; best[0]:
            best = (score, e, jacc, shared)
    if best and best[0] &gt;= 0.58:
        e = best[1]
        used_neon.add(e[&#39;_idx&#39;])
        matches.append({
            &#39;score&#39;: round(best[0], 3),
            &#39;catalog_name&#39;: c[&#39;canonical_name&#39;],
            &#39;catalog_date&#39;: c.get(&#39;date&#39;) or c.get(&#39;date_incident&#39;),
            &#39;catalog_sources&#39;: &#39;+&#39;.join(c.get(&#39;sources&#39;) or []),
            &#39;catalog_url&#39;: c.get(&#39;primary_url&#39;),

            &#39;neon_name&#39;: neon_label(e),
            &#39;neon_date&#39;: neon_date_str(e),
            &#39;neon_location&#39;: e.get(&#39;location&#39;),
            &#39;shared_tokens&#39;: sorted(best[3]),
        })

matched_cat_names = {m[&#39;catalog_name&#39;] for m in matches}
matched_neon_ids = {m[&#39;neon_id&#39;] for m in matches}

catalog_only = [c for c in catalog if c[&#39;canonical_name&#39;] not in matched_cat_names]
neon_only = [e for e in neon if e[&#39;id&#39;] not in matched_neon_ids]

# Year distribution of neon
from collections import Counter
neon_era = Counter()
for e in neon:
    y = e[&#39;_year&#39;]
    if y is None: neon_era[&#39;undated&#39;] += 1
    elif y &lt; 1900: neon_era[&#39;pre-1900&#39;] += 1
    elif y &lt; 1940: neon_era[&#39;1900-1939&#39;] += 1
    elif y &lt; 1980: neon_era[&#39;1940-1979&#39;] += 1
    elif y &lt; 2000: neon_era[&#39;1980-1999&#39;] += 1
    else: neon_era[&#39;2000+&#39;] += 1

# Write comparison report
report = {
    &#39;meta&#39;: {
        &#39;neon_events&#39;: len(neon),
        &#39;catalog_records&#39;: len(catalog),
        &#39;matched&#39;: len(matches),
        &#39;catalog_only&#39;: len(catalog_only),
        &#39;neon_only&#39;: len(neon_only),
        &#39;match_rate_catalog&#39;: round(len(matches)/len(catalog), 3),
        &#39;match_rate_neon&#39;: round(len(matches)/len(neon), 3),
        &#39;neon_era_breakdown&#39;: dict(neon_era),
        &#39;compared_at&#39;: __import__(&#39;datetime&#39;).datetime.now().isoformat(timespec=&#39;seconds&#39;),

    &#39;matches&#39;: sorted(matches, key=lambda m: -m[&#39;score&#39;]),
    &#39;catalog_only&#39;: [{

        &#39;date&#39;: c.get(&#39;date&#39;) or c.get(&#39;date_incident&#39;),

        &#39;id&#39;: e[&#39;id&#39;],
        &#39;name&#39;: neon_label(e),
        &#39;date&#39;: neon_date_str(e),
        &#39;location&#39;: e.get(&#39;location&#39;),
        &#39;summary&#39;: ((e.get(&#39;summary&#39;) or e.get(&#39;description&#39;) or &#39;&#39;)[:180]),
    } for e in neon_only],
}

(ROOT / &#39;neon-vs-catalog-comparison.json&#39;).write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding=&#39;utf-8&#39;)

# Markdown report
lines = []
m = report[&#39;meta&#39;]
lines += [

    &#39;&#39;,

]

```bash
import json, re, unicodedata, csv
from difflib import SequenceMatcher

def normalize(s: str) -> str:

    s = s.lower().replace('ʻ','').replace("'",'').replace('"','')
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', s)
    tokens = [t for t in s.split() if t and t not in STOP and len(t) > 1]
    return ' '.join(tokens)

def years(s: str) -> set[int]:
    ys = set()
    for y in re.findall(r'\b(\d{3,4})\b', s or ''):
        yi = int(y)
        if 100 <= yi <= 2100:
            ys.add(yi)
    return ys

def neon_label(r):
    return (r.get('name') or r.get('title') or '').strip()

def neon_date_str(r):
    d = r.get('date') or ''
    return d[:10] if d else ''

def neon_year(r):
    d = neon_date_str(r)
    if d and d[:4].isdigit():
        y = int(d[:4])
        # filter garbage years like 0196
        if 100 <= y <= 2100:
            return y
    return None

# Prepare sides
for i, c in enumerate(catalog):
    names = [c.get('canonical_name','')] + list(c.get('aliases') or [])
    c['_idx'] = i
    c['_norms'] = [normalize(n) for n in names if n]
    c['_years'] = years(c.get('date','') + ' ' + c.get('date_incident','') + ' ' + ' '.join(names))

for i, e in enumerate(neon):
    label = neon_label(e)
    e['_idx'] = i
    e['_norm'] = normalize(label)
    e['_year'] = neon_year(e)
    e['_years'] = years(label) | ({e['_year']} if e['_year'] else set())

# Match catalog → neon
matches = []  # list of dicts
used_neon = set()

# Strong keyword aliases for famous cases
ALIASES = [
    (['roswell'], ['roswell']),
    (['kenneth arnold', 'arnold'], ['kenneth arnold', 'arnold']),
    (['battle los angeles', 'battle la'], ['battle los angeles', 'los angeles']),
    (['phoenix'], ['phoenix']),
    (['nimitz', 'tic tac', 'tic-tac'], ['nimitz', 'tic tac', 'fravor']),
    (['mcminnville', 'trent'], ['mcminnville', 'trent']),
    (['rendlesham'], ['rendlesham']),
    (['ariel', 'ruwa', 'zimbabwe'], ['ariel', 'ruwa', 'zimbabwe']),
    (['westall'], ['westall']),
    (['varginha'], ['varginha']),
    (['foo fighter'], ['foo fighter']),
    (['ghost rocket'], ['ghost rocket']),
    (['oumuamua', 'omuamua'], ['oumuamua', 'omuamua']),
    (['ohare', "o hare"], ['ohare', "o hare"]),
    (['socorro', 'zamora'], ['socorro', 'zamora']),
    (['belgium', 'belgian'], ['belgium', 'belgian']),
    (['mainbrace'], ['mainbrace']),
    (['washington'], ['washington']),
    (['carter'], ['carter']),
    (['reagan'], ['reagan']),
    (['trinity'], ['trinity']),
    (['mantell'], ['mantell']),
    (['malmstrom'], ['malmstrom']),
    (['area 51'], ['area 51']),
    (['blue book'], ['blue book']),
    (['project sign'], ['project sign', 'sign']),
    (['project grudge'], ['project grudge', 'grudge']),
    (['sputnik'], ['sputnik']),
    (['condon'], ['condon']),
    (['robertson panel'], ['robertson']),
    (['aatip'], ['aatip']),
    (['gimbal', 'gofast', 'go fast'], ['gimbal', 'gofast', 'go fast', 'theodore roosevelt']),
    (['florence', 'fiorentina'], ['florence', 'italy', 'fiorentina']),
    (['war worlds', 'orson welles'], ['war worlds', 'orson', 'welles']),
]

def alias_hit(cat_text, neon_text, pair):
    a, b = pair
    return any(x in cat_text for x in a) and any(x in neon_text for x in b)

for c in catalog:
    cat_blob = ' '.join(c['_norms'])
    best = None
    for e in neon:
        if e['_idx'] in used_neon:
            continue
        # year gate when both have years
        if c['_years'] and e['_years']:
            overlap = c['_years'] & e['_years']
            near = any(abs(a-b) <= 5 for a in c['_years'] for b in e['_years'])
            if not overlap and not near:
                # still allow strong alias hits across date noise
                if not any(alias_hit(cat_blob, e['_norm'], p) for p in ALIASES):
                    continue
        scores = [SequenceMatcher(None, n, e['_norm']).ratio() for n in c['_norms'] if n]
        ta = set(cat_blob.split()); tb = set(e['_norm'].split())
        jacc = len(ta & tb)/len(ta|tb) if ta and tb else 0
        score = max(scores + [0] + [jacc])
        shared = {x for x in (ta & tb) if len(x) >= 4}
        score += 0.1 * min(len(shared), 3)
        # alias boost
        if any(alias_hit(cat_blob, e['_norm'], p) for p in ALIASES):
            score += 0.35
        if best is None or score > best[0]:
            best = (score, e, jacc, shared)
    if best and best[0] >= 0.58:
        e = best[1]
        used_neon.add(e['_idx'])
        matches.append({
            'score': round(best[0], 3),
            'catalog_name': c['canonical_name'],
            'catalog_date': c.get('date') or c.get('date_incident'),
            'catalog_sources': '+'.join(c.get('sources') or []),
            'catalog_url': c.get('primary_url'),
            'neon_id': e['id'],
            'neon_name': neon_label(e),
            'neon_date': neon_date_str(e),
            'neon_location': e.get('location'),
            'shared_tokens': sorted(best[3]),
        })

matched_cat_names = {m['catalog_name'] for m in matches}
matched_neon_ids = {m['neon_id'] for m in matches}

catalog_only = [c for c in catalog if c['canonical_name'] not in matched_cat_names]
neon_only = [e for e in neon if e['id'] not in matched_neon_ids]

# Year distribution of neon
from collections import Counter
neon_era = Counter()
for e in neon:
    y = e['_year']
    if y is None: neon_era['undated'] += 1
    elif y < 1900: neon_era['pre-1900'] += 1
    elif y < 1940: neon_era['1900-1939'] += 1
    elif y < 1980: neon_era['1940-1979'] += 1
    elif y < 2000: neon_era['1980-1999'] += 1
    else: neon_era['2000+'] += 1

# Write comparison report
report = {
    'meta': {
        'neon_events': len(neon),
        'catalog_records': len(catalog),
        'matched': len(matches),
        'catalog_only': len(catalog_only),
        'neon_only': len(neon_only),
        'match_rate_catalog': round(len(matches)/len(catalog), 3),
        'match_rate_neon': round(len(matches)/len(neon), 3),
        'neon_era_breakdown': dict(neon_era),
        'compared_at': __import__('datetime').datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds'),
    },
    'matches': sorted(matches, key=lambda m: -m['score']),
    'catalog_only': [{
        'name': c['canonical_name'],
        'date': c.get('date') or c.get('date_incident'),
        'sources': '+'.join(c.get('sources') or []),
        'url': c.get('primary_url'),
        'claim': (c.get('claim') or '')[:160],
    } for c in catalog_only],
    'neon_only': [{
        'id': e['id'],
        'name': neon_label(e),
        'date': neon_date_str(e),
        'location': e.get('location'),
        'summary': ((e.get('summary') or e.get('description') or '')[:180]),
    } for e in neon_only],
}

(ROOT / 'neon-vs-catalog-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')

# TSV matches + gaps
with (ROOT / 'neon-vs-catalog-matches.tsv').open('w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(matches[0].keys()) if matches else ['catalog_name'], delimiter='\t')
    w.writeheader()
    for m in sorted(matches, key=lambda m: -m['score']):
        w.writerow({**m, 'shared_tokens': ','.join(m['shared_tokens'])})

with (ROOT / 'neon-vs-catalog-gaps.tsv').open('w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    w = csv.writer(f, delimiter='\t')
    w.writerow(['bucket','name','date','id_or_url','sources_or_location'])
    for c in catalog_only:
        w.writerow(['catalog_only', c['canonical_name'], c.get('date') or c.get('date_incident'), c.get('primary_url'), '+'.join(c.get('sources') or [])])
    for e in neon_only:
        w.writerow(['neon_only', neon_label(e), neon_date_str(e), e['id'], e.get('location') or ''])

# Markdown report
lines = []
m = report['meta']
lines += [
    '# Neon Events vs UFO Database Catalog',
    '',
    f"**Compared:** {m['compared_at']}",
    '',
    '## Summary',
    '',
    f"| Side | Count |",
    f"|------|------:|",
    f"| Neon `events` | {m['neon_events']} |",
    f"| Merged UFO DB catalog | {m['catalog_records']} |",
    f"| **Matched** | **{m['matched']}** |",

    f"| Neon-only (not in catalog) | {m['neon_only']} |",
    '',

    '',
    '### Neon era mix',
    '',
]
for k in ['pre-1900','1900-1939','1940-1979','1980-1999','2000+','undated']:
    lines.append(f"- {k}: {m['neon_era_breakdown'].get(k,0)}")

lines += ['', '## Matches (high confidence)', '']
for x in sorted(matches, key=lambda z: -z['score']):
    lines.append(f"- **{x['catalog_name']}** ({x['catalog_date']}) ↔ `{x['neon_name']}` ({x['neon_date']}) · score {x['score']}")

lines += ['', '## Catalog-only (candidates to ingest into Neon)', '']
for c in catalog_only:

print(json.dumps(m, indent=2))
print('\nTOP MATCHES:')
for x in sorted(matches, key=lambda z: -z['score'])[:25]:
```

from __future__ import annotations
import csv, json, re, unicodedata, hashlib
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from difflib import SequenceMatcher
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

ROOT = Path(&#39;.scratch/ufo-database-merge&#39;)
CSV_PATH = Path(&#39;apps/app/scripts/xata-exports/exports/events.csv&#39;)

with CSV_PATH.open(newline=&#39;&#39;, encoding=&#39;utf-8&#39;) as f:
    xata_raw = list(csv.DictReader(f))
neon = json.loads((ROOT/&#39;neon-events.json&#39;).read_text())[&#39;records&#39;]
catalog = json.loads((ROOT/&#39;merged-catalog.json&#39;).read_text())[&#39;records&#39;]

STOP = {
    &#39;the&#39;,&#39;a&#39;,&#39;an&#39;,&#39;of&#39;,&#39;and&#39;,&#39;or&#39;,&#39;ufo&#39;,&#39;ufos&#39;,&#39;uap&#39;,&#39;uaps&#39;,&#39;incident&#39;,&#39;sighting&#39;,&#39;sightings&#39;,
    &#39;video&#39;,&#39;videos&#39;,&#39;photo&#39;,&#39;photos&#39;,&#39;over&#39;,&#39;in&#39;,&#39;on&#39;,&#39;at&#39;,&#39;to&#39;,&#39;for&#39;,&#39;with&#39;,&#39;by&#39;,&#39;from&#39;,
    &#39;seen&#39;,&#39;witnessed&#39;,&#39;case&#39;,&#39;report&#39;,&#39;event&#39;,&#39;phenomenon&#39;,&#39;celestial&#39;,
}

def normalize(s: str) -&gt; str:
    s = unicodedata.normalize(&#39;NFKD&#39;, s or &#39;&#39;)
    s = &#39;&#39;.join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    s = s.lower().replace(&#39;ʻ&#39;,&#39;&#39;).replace(&#34;&#39;&#34;,&#39;&#39;).replace(&#39;&#34;&#39;,&#39;&#39;)
    s = re.sub(r&#39;[^a-z0-9]+&#39;, &#39; &#39;, s)
    return &#39; &#39;.join(t for t in s.split() if t and t not in STOP and len(t)&gt;1)

def years(s: str) -&gt; set[int]:
    out=set()
    for y in re.findall(r&#39;\b(\d{3,4})\b&#39;, s or &#39;&#39;):
        yi=int(y)
        if 100&lt;=yi&lt;=2100: out.add(yi)
    return out

def year_from_iso(d: str|None):
    if not d: return None
    m = re.match(r&#39;^(\d{1,4})&#39;, d.strip())
    if not m: return None
    y=int(m.group(1))
    return y if 100&lt;=y&lt;=2100 else None

def content_fp(name, date, location, description):
    blob = &#39;|&#39;.join([
        normalize(name or &#39;&#39;),
        (date or &#39;&#39;)[:10],
        normalize(location or &#39;&#39;),
        normalize((description or &#39;&#39;)[:240]),
    ])
    return hashlib.sha1(blob.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]

def era(y):
    if y is None: return &#39;undated&#39;
    if y &lt; 1900: return &#39;pre-1900&#39;
    if y &lt; 1940: return &#39;1900-1939&#39;
    if y &lt; 1980: return &#39;1940-1979&#39;
    if y &lt; 2000: return &#39;1980-1999&#39;
    if y &lt; 2015: return &#39;2000-2014&#39;
    return &#39;2015+&#39;

# ---- Xata redundancy analysis ----
id_counts = Counter(r[&#39;id&#39;] for r in xata_raw)
dup_ids = {i:c for i,c in id_counts.items() if c&gt;1}
print(&#39;unique Xata ids:&#39;, len(id_counts))
print(&#39;ids with &gt;1 row:&#39;, len(dup_ids))
print(&#39;extra rows from id dups:&#39;, sum(c-1 for c in dup_ids.values()))

# exact content duplicates (ignoring id)
fps = defaultdict(list)
for i,r in enumerate(xata_raw):

# Field delta for shared IDs: did Neon lose data?
field_deltas = Counter()

for iid in sorted(id_both):
    x, n = xata_by_id[iid], neon_by_id[iid]
    for f in [&#39;name&#39;,&#39;description&#39;,&#39;location&#39;,&#39;date&#39;,&#39;latitude&#39;,&#39;longitude&#39;,&#39;category&#39;,&#39;summary&#39;,&#39;title&#39;]:
        xv = (x.get(f) or &#39;&#39;).strip()
        nv = n.get(f)
        if isinstance(nv, list):
            nv = str(nv)
        nv = (&#39;&#39; if nv is None else str(nv)).strip()
        # normalize dates to first 10 chars
        if f==&#39;date&#39;:
            xv, nv = xv[:10], nv[:10]
        if xv and not nv:
            field_deltas[f+&#39; lost_in_neon&#39;] += 1
        elif nv and not xv:
            field_deltas[f+&#39; gained_in_neon&#39;] += 1
        elif xv and nv and xv != nv and f in (&#39;name&#39;,&#39;location&#39;,&#39;description&#39;):
            # meaningful text change
            if SequenceMatcher(None, xv[:200], nv[:200]).ratio() &lt; 0.95:
                field_deltas[f+&#39; changed&#39;] += 1
                if len(sample_diffs) &lt; 8 and f==&#39;name&#39;:
                    sample_diffs.append((iid, xv[:60], nv[:60]))

print(&#39;Field deltas on shared IDs:&#39;)

# Category distribution
def parse_cat(s):
    s=(s or &#39;&#39;).strip()
    if not s: return []
    try:
        v=ast.literal_eval(s) if s.startswith(&#39;[&#39;) else [s]
        return [str(x) for x in v]
    except Exception:
        return [s]

neon_cats = Counter()
for r in neon:
    cats = r.get(&#39;category&#39;) or []
    if isinstance(cats, str):
        cats = parse_cat(cats)
    for c in cats:
        neon_cats[str(c)] += 1

print(&#39;Neon categories:&#39;, neon_cats.most_common(15))

# ---- Prepare entities for fuzzy three-way ----
def prep_db(rows, source, label_fn, date_fn, loc_fn=lambda r: r.get(&#39;location&#39;), desc_fn=lambda r: r.get(&#39;description&#39;) or r.get(&#39;summary&#39;) or &#39;&#39;):
    out=[]
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        label = label_fn(r)
        d = date_fn(r)
        out.append({
            &#39;source&#39;: source,
            &#39;idx&#39;: i,
            &#39;id&#39;: r.get(&#39;id&#39;),
            &#39;label&#39;: label,
            &#39;norm&#39;: normalize(label),
            &#39;date&#39;: d,
            &#39;year&#39;: year_from_iso(d) if d and re.match(r&#39;^\d&#39;, d or &#39;&#39;) else (min(years(label)) if years(label) else None),
            &#39;years&#39;: years(label) | ({year_from_iso(d)} if year_from_iso(d) else set()),
            &#39;location&#39;: loc_fn(r) or &#39;&#39;,
            &#39;description&#39;: (desc_fn(r) or &#39;&#39;)[:300],
            &#39;raw&#39;: r,
        })
    return out

def alias_hit(a,b):
    for left,right in ALIASES:
        if any(x in a for x in left) and any(x in b for x in right):
            return True
    return False

def score_pair(a_norms, a_years, b_norm, b_years):
    # a_norms: list
    best=0
    for an in a_norms:
        ratio = SequenceMatcher(None, an, b_norm).ratio()
        ta,tb=set(an.split()), set(b_norm.split())
        jacc = len(ta&amp;tb)/len(ta|tb) if ta and tb else 0
        s=max(ratio,jacc)
        shared={x for x in ta&amp;tb if len(x)&gt;=4}
        s += 0.1*min(len(shared),3)
        if alias_hit(an, b_norm):
            s += 0.35
        best=max(best,s)
    # year gate soft
    if a_years and b_years:
        if not (a_years &amp; b_years) and not any(abs(x-y)&lt;=5 for x in a_years for y in b_years):
            if best &lt; 0.9:  # only keep very strong alias/name
                return 0
    return best

def match_sets(left, right, thresh=0.58):
    &#34;&#34;&#34;Greedy match left→right. left items need norms list or norm.&#34;&#34;&#34;
    used=set(); pairs=[]
    for L in left:
        norms = L.get(&#39;norms&#39;) or [L[&#39;norm&#39;]]
        best=None
        for R in right:
            if R[&#39;idx&#39;] in used: continue
            s = score_pair(norms, L[&#39;years&#39;], R[&#39;norm&#39;], R[&#39;years&#39;])
            if best is None or s&gt;best[0]:
                best=(s,R)
        if best and best[0] &gt;= thresh:
            used.add(best[1][&#39;idx&#39;])
            pairs.append((L, best[1], round(best[0],3)))
    return pairs, used

        if key not in used_pairs:
            used_pairs.add(key)
            intra_fuzzy.append((a, best[1], best[0]))

```bash
from __future__ import annotations
import csv, json, re, unicodedata, hashlib
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from difflib import SequenceMatcher
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

ROOT = Path('.scratch/ufo-database-merge')
CSV_PATH = Path('apps/app/scripts/xata-exports/exports/events.csv')

with CSV_PATH.open(newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    xata_raw = list(csv.DictReader(f))
neon = json.loads((ROOT/'neon-events.json').read_text())['records']
catalog = json.loads((ROOT/'merged-catalog.json').read_text())['records']

STOP = {
    'the','a','an','of','and','or','ufo','ufos','uap','uaps','incident','sighting','sightings',
    'video','videos','photo','photos','over','in','on','at','to','for','with','by','from',
    'seen','witnessed','case','report','event','phenomenon','celestial',
}

def normalize(s: str) -> str:
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', s or '')
    s = ''.join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    s = s.lower().replace('ʻ','').replace("'",'').replace('"','')
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', s)
    return ' '.join(t for t in s.split() if t and t not in STOP and len(t)>1)

def years(s: str) -> set[int]:
    out=set()
    for y in re.findall(r'\b(\d{3,4})\b', s or ''):
        yi=int(y)
        if 100<=yi<=2100: out.add(yi)
    return out

def year_from_iso(d: str|None):
    if not d: return None
    m = re.match(r'^(\d{1,4})', d.strip())
    if not m: return None
    y=int(m.group(1))
    return y if 100<=y<=2100 else None

def content_fp(name, date, location, description):
    blob = '|'.join([
        normalize(name or ''),
        (date or '')[:10],
        normalize(location or ''),
        normalize((description or '')[:240]),
    ])
    return hashlib.sha1(blob.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]

def era(y):
    if y is None: return 'undated'
    if y < 1900: return 'pre-1900'
    if y < 1940: return '1900-1939'
    if y < 1980: return '1940-1979'
    if y < 2000: return '1980-1999'
    if y < 2015: return '2000-2014'
    return '2015+'

# ---- Xata redundancy analysis ----
id_counts = Counter(r['id'] for r in xata_raw)
dup_ids = {i:c for i,c in id_counts.items() if c>1}
print('unique Xata ids:', len(id_counts))
print('ids with >1 row:', len(dup_ids))
print('extra rows from id dups:', sum(c-1 for c in dup_ids.values()))

# exact content duplicates (ignoring id)
fps = defaultdict(list)
for i,r in enumerate(xata_raw):
    fp = content_fp(r.get('name'), r.get('date'), r.get('location'), r.get('description'))
    fps[fp].append(i)
content_dups = {k:v for k,v in fps.items() if len(v)>1}
print('content-fingerprint groups with >1 row:', len(content_dups))
print('rows in content-dup groups:', sum(len(v) for v in content_dups.values()))

# near-duplicate names (same norm name + same year)
name_year = defaultdict(list)
for i,r in enumerate(xata_raw):
    key = (normalize(r.get('name','')), year_from_iso(r.get('date')))
    name_year[key].append(i)
ny_dups = {k:v for k,v in name_year.items() if len(v)>1 and k[0]}
print('same normalized name+year groups:', len(ny_dups))
print('rows in those groups:', sum(len(v) for v in ny_dups.values()))

# Deduped Xata working set: prefer first occurrence per id, then unique content
seen_ids=set(); xata=[]
for r in xata_raw:
    if r['id'] in seen_ids: continue
    seen_ids.add(r['id'])
    xata.append(r)
print('Xata after id-dedupe:', len(xata))

# Also build content-deduped set for "true unique events"
seen_fp=set(); xata_unique=[]
for r in xata:
    fp = content_fp(r.get('name'), r.get('date'), r.get('location'), r.get('description'))
    if fp in seen_fp: continue
    seen_fp.add(fp)
    xata_unique.append(r)
print('Xata after id+content dedupe:', len(xata_unique))

# Neon vs Xata by ID
xata_by_id = {r['id']: r for r in xata}
neon_by_id = {r['id']: r for r in neon}
id_both = set(xata_by_id) & set(neon_by_id)
id_xata_only = set(xata_by_id) - set(neon_by_id)
id_neon_only = set(neon_by_id) - set(xata_by_id)
print('\nID overlap after xata id-dedupe:')
print(' both:', len(id_both), 'xata-only:', len(id_xata_only), 'neon-only:', len(id_neon_only))

# Field delta for shared IDs: did Neon lose data?
field_deltas = Counter()
sample_diffs = []
for iid in sorted(id_both):
    x, n = xata_by_id[iid], neon_by_id[iid]
    for f in ['name','description','location','date','latitude','longitude','category','summary','title']:
        xv = (x.get(f) or '').strip()
        nv = n.get(f)
        if isinstance(nv, list):
            nv = str(nv)
        nv = ('' if nv is None else str(nv)).strip()
        # normalize dates to first 10 chars
        if f=='date':
            xv, nv = xv[:10], nv[:10]
        if xv and not nv:
            field_deltas[f+' lost_in_neon'] += 1
        elif nv and not xv:
            field_deltas[f+' gained_in_neon'] += 1
        elif xv and nv and xv != nv and f in ('name','location','description'):
            # meaningful text change
            if SequenceMatcher(None, xv[:200], nv[:200]).ratio() < 0.95:
                field_deltas[f+' changed'] += 1
                if len(sample_diffs) < 8 and f=='name':
                    sample_diffs.append((iid, xv[:60], nv[:60]))

print('Field deltas on shared IDs:')
for k,v in field_deltas.most_common():
    print(f'  {k}: {v}')
print('sample name changes:', sample_diffs[:5])

# Why is Neon 142 vs Xata 283 unique ids?
print('\nXata unique ids:', len(xata_by_id), 'Neon:', len(neon_by_id))
# Wait - if xata after id-dedupe equals unique ids...
# earlier unique ids was printed

# Category distribution
def parse_cat(s):
    s=(s or '').strip()
    if not s: return []
    try:
        v=ast.literal_eval(s) if s.startswith('[') else [s]
        return [str(x) for x in v]
    except Exception:
        return [s]

import ast
xata_cats = Counter()
for r in xata:
    for c in parse_cat(r.get('category')):
        xata_cats[c]+=1
neon_cats = Counter()
for r in neon:
    cats = r.get('category') or []
    if isinstance(cats, str):
        cats = parse_cat(cats)
    for c in cats:
        neon_cats[str(c)] += 1
print('\nXata categories:', xata_cats.most_common(15))
print('Neon categories:', neon_cats.most_common(15))

# Era
xata_era = Counter(era(year_from_iso(r.get('date'))) for r in xata)
neon_era = Counter(era(year_from_iso(r.get('date'))) for r in neon)
print('Xata era:', dict(xata_era))
print('Neon era:', dict(neon_era))

# ---- Prepare entities for fuzzy three-way ----
def prep_db(rows, source, label_fn, date_fn, loc_fn=lambda r: r.get('location'), desc_fn=lambda r: r.get('description') or r.get('summary') or ''):
    out=[]
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        label = label_fn(r)
        d = date_fn(r)
        out.append({
            'source': source,
            'idx': i,
            'id': r.get('id'),
            'label': label,
            'norm': normalize(label),
            'date': d,
            'year': year_from_iso(d) if d and re.match(r'^\d', d or '') else (min(years(label)) if years(label) else None),
            'years': years(label) | ({year_from_iso(d)} if year_from_iso(d) else set()),
            'location': loc_fn(r) or '',
            'description': (desc_fn(r) or '')[:300],
            'raw': r,
        })
    return out

xata_e = prep_db(xata, 'xata', lambda r: (r.get('name') or r.get('title') or '').strip(), lambda r: (r.get('date') or '')[:10])
neon_e = prep_db(neon, 'neon', lambda r: (r.get('name') or r.get('title') or '').strip(), lambda r: (r.get('date') or '')[:10])

cat_e=[]
for i,c in enumerate(catalog):
    names=[c.get('canonical_name','')] + list(c.get('aliases') or [])
    label=c.get('canonical_name','')
    d=c.get('date') or c.get('date_incident') or ''
    # try extract iso-ish from freeform later via years
    cat_e.append({
        'source':'catalog','idx':i,'id':None,'label':label,
        'norm': normalize(label),
        'norms': [normalize(n) for n in names if n],
        'date': d,
        'year': min(years(d+' '+label)) if years(d+' '+label) else None,
        'years': years(d+' '+' '.join(names)),
        'location':'',
        'description': (c.get('description') or c.get('claim') or '')[:300],
        'raw': c,
        'sources_flag': '+'.join(c.get('sources') or []),
        'url': c.get('primary_url'),
    })

ALIASES = [
    (['roswell'], ['roswell']),
    (['kenneth arnold','arnold'], ['kenneth arnold','arnold']),
    (['battle los angeles','battle la'], ['battle los angeles','los angeles']),
    (['phoenix'], ['phoenix']),
    (['nimitz','tic tac'], ['nimitz','tic tac','fravor']),
    (['mcminnville','trent'], ['mcminnville','trent']),
    (['rendlesham'], ['rendlesham']),
    (['ariel','ruwa','zimbabwe'], ['ariel','ruwa','zimbabwe']),
    (['westall'], ['westall']),
    (['varginha'], ['varginha']),
    (['foo fighter'], ['foo fighter']),
    (['ghost rocket'], ['ghost rocket']),
    (['oumuamua','omuamua'], ['oumuamua','omuamua']),
    (['ohare','o hare'], ['ohare','o hare']),
    (['socorro','zamora'], ['socorro','zamora']),
    (['belgium','belgian'], ['belgium','belgian']),
    (['mainbrace'], ['mainbrace']),
    (['mantell'], ['mantell']),
    (['malmstrom'], ['malmstrom']),
    (['area 51'], ['area 51']),
    (['blue book'], ['blue book']),
    (['project sign'], ['project sign']),
    (['project grudge'], ['project grudge']),
    (['sputnik'], ['sputnik']),
    (['condon'], ['condon']),
    (['robertson'], ['robertson']),
    (['aatip'], ['aatip']),
    (['gimbal','gofast','go fast'], ['gimbal','gofast','go fast','theodore roosevelt']),
    (['florence','fiorentina'], ['florence','italy','franchi']),
    (['war worlds','orson'], ['war worlds','orson','welles']),
    (['carter'], ['carter']),
    (['reagan'], ['reagan']),
    (['trinity'], ['trinity']),
    (['gorman'], ['gorman']),
    (['tehran'], ['tehran']),
    (['trans en provence'], ['trans en provence']),
    (['chiles whitted'], ['chiles whitted']),
    (['nash fortenberry'], ['nash fortenberry']),
]

def alias_hit(a,b):
    for left,right in ALIASES:
        if any(x in a for x in left) and any(x in b for x in right):
            return True
    return False

def score_pair(a_norms, a_years, b_norm, b_years):
    # a_norms: list
    best=0
    for an in a_norms:
        ratio = SequenceMatcher(None, an, b_norm).ratio()
        ta,tb=set(an.split()), set(b_norm.split())
        jacc = len(ta&tb)/len(ta|tb) if ta and tb else 0
        s=max(ratio,jacc)
        shared={x for x in ta&tb if len(x)>=4}
        s += 0.1*min(len(shared),3)
        if alias_hit(an, b_norm):
            s += 0.35
        best=max(best,s)
    # year gate soft
    if a_years and b_years:
        if not (a_years & b_years) and not any(abs(x-y)<=5 for x in a_years for y in b_years):
            if best < 0.9:  # only keep very strong alias/name
                return 0
    return best

def match_sets(left, right, thresh=0.58):
    """Greedy match left→right. left items need norms list or norm."""
    used=set(); pairs=[]
    for L in left:
        norms = L.get('norms') or [L['norm']]
        best=None
        for R in right:
            if R['idx'] in used: continue
            s = score_pair(norms, L['years'], R['norm'], R['years'])
            if best is None or s>best[0]:
                best=(s,R)
        if best and best[0] >= thresh:
            used.add(best[1]['idx'])
            pairs.append((L, best[1], round(best[0],3)))
    return pairs, used

# Catalog ↔ Xata, Catalog ↔ Neon, and Neon↔Xata fuzzy (for non-id matches among xata-only)
cat_xata, used_x_from_cat = match_sets(cat_e, xata_e, 0.58)
cat_neon, used_n_from_cat = match_sets(cat_e, neon_e, 0.58)

# For catalog items matched to either
cat_in_xata = {L['idx'] for L,_,_ in cat_xata}
cat_in_neon = {L['idx'] for L,_,_ in cat_neon}

# Three-way classification of catalog
venn_cat = {'all_three':[], 'cat_xata':[], 'cat_neon':[], 'cat_only':[], 'cat_xata_neon_conflict':[]}
# rebuild via lookups
cx = {L['idx']:(R,s) for L,R,s in cat_xata}
cn = {L['idx']:(R,s) for L,R,s in cat_neon}
for c in cat_e:
    i=c['idx']
    has_x = i in cx
    has_n = i in cn
    if has_x and has_n:
        venn_cat['all_three'].append(c)
    elif has_x:
        venn_cat['cat_xata'].append(c)
    elif has_n:
        venn_cat['cat_neon'].append(c)
    else:
        venn_cat['cat_only'].append(c)

# Xata-only vs Neon (by ID already) — fuzzy: are xata-only near-dups of neon events?
xata_only_rows = [e for e in xata_e if e['id'] in id_xata_only]
neon_all = neon_e
xo_matched, _ = match_sets(
    [{**e, 'norms':[e['norm']]} for e in xata_only_rows],
    neon_all,
    0.72,  # higher bar — these should be true near-dupes if any
)
print('\nXata-only rows:', len(xata_only_rows))
print('Xata-only that fuzzy-match a Neon event (near-dup):', len(xo_matched))

# Within-Xata near duplicates among unique ids
# Compare each pair with same year — expensive but n=283 max unique ~?
# Use name_year groups on id-deduped
ny2=defaultdict(list)
for e in xata_e:
    ny2[(e['norm'], e['year'])].append(e)
intra=[]
for (nm,y), group in ny2.items():
    if len(group)<2 or not nm: continue
    # also check different ids with high name similarity across close years
    for i in range(len(group)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(group)):
            intra.append((group[i], group[j]))
# also cross-year near name matches
# bucket by first significant token
print('Intra-Xata exact name+year multi-id groups:', sum(1 for g in ny2.values() if len(g)>1))
print('pairs in those groups:', len(intra))

# Broader fuzzy intra-xata: for each event, best other with score>=0.85 and year near
intra_fuzzy=[]
used_pairs=set()
for i,a in enumerate(xata_e):
    best=None
    for j,b in enumerate(xata_e):
        if j<=i: continue
        if a['id']==b['id']: continue
        s=score_pair([a['norm']], a['years'], b['norm'], b['years'])
        if s>=0.85:
            if best is None or s>best[0]:
                best=(s,b)
    if best:
        key=tuple(sorted([a['id'], best[1]['id']]))
        if key not in used_pairs:
            used_pairs.add(key)
            intra_fuzzy.append((a, best[1], best[0]))
print('Intra-Xata fuzzy near-dup pairs (score>=0.85):', len(intra_fuzzy))

# Catalog coverage
print('\nCatalog venn:')
for k,v in venn_cat.items():
    print(f'  {k}: {len(v)}')

# Xata redundancy examples
print('\nTop ID-dup counts:')
for iid,c in sorted(dup_ids.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1])[:10]:
    name = next(r['name'] for r in xata_raw if r['id']==iid)
    print(f'  {c}x {iid} {name[:50]!r}')

print('\nSample content-dup groups:')
shown=0
for fp, idxs in sorted(content_dups.items(), key=lambda x:-len(x[1])):
    rows=[xata_raw[i] for i in idxs]
    ids=set(r['id'] for r in rows)
    print(f'  n={len(idxs)} ids={len(ids)} name={rows[0]["name"][:50]!r} date={rows[0]["date"][:10]}')
    shown+=1
    if shown>=8: break

# Build comprehensive report JSON
# Classify xata-only into: true unique gaps vs near-dups of neon
xo_matched_ids={L['id'] for L,_,_ in xo_matched}
xata_only_unique = [e for e in xata_only_rows if e['id'] not in xo_matched_ids]
xata_only_neardup = [e for e in xata_only_rows if e['id'] in xo_matched_ids]

# Catalog only details split institutional vs cases
INST_KEYS = ['project','hearing','pentagon','nasa','aaro','aatip','ndaa','condon','robertson','majestic','national security','sputnik','area 51','mufon','assessment','defense','united nation','blue book','geipan','sky canada','war of the worlds','atomic','hiroshima','eisenhower','moon landing','avro','flying saucer']

def is_inst(name):
    n=name.lower()
    return any(k in n for k in INST_KEYS)

report = {
  'meta': {
    'compared_at': datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds'),
    'sources': {
      'xata_csv': str(CSV_PATH),
      'neon_json': str(ROOT/'neon-events.json'),

    },
    'counts': {

    },

    },
    'redundancy': {

    for iid,c in sorted(dup_ids.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1])[:20]
  ],
  'intra_xata_fuzzy_pairs': [
    {'score': round(s,3), 'a_id': a['id'], 'a_name': a['label'], 'a_date': a['date'],
     'b_id': b['id'], 'b_name': b['label'], 'b_date': b['date']}
    for a,b,s in sorted(intra_fuzzy, key=lambda x:-x[2])[:40]
  ],
  'xata_only_true_unique': [
    {'id': e['id'], 'name': e['label'], 'date': e['date'], 'location': e['location'],
     'description': e['description'][:180], 'era': era(e['year'])}
    for e in sorted(xata_only_unique, key=lambda e: (e['year'] or 9999, e['label']))
  ],
  'xata_only_near_dup_of_neon': [
    {'xata_id': L['id'], 'xata_name': L['label'], 'xata_date': L['date'],
     'neon_id': R['id'], 'neon_name': R['label'], 'neon_date': R['date'], 'score': s}
    for L,R,s in xo_matched
  ],
  'catalog_in_all_three': [
    {'catalog': c['label'], 'date': c['date'], 'xata': cx[c['idx']][0]['label'],
     'neon': cn[c['idx']][0]['label'], 'x_score': cx[c['idx']][1], 'n_score': cn[c['idx']][1]}
    for c in venn_cat['all_three']
  ],
  'catalog_in_xata_missing_neon': [
    {'catalog': c['label'], 'date': c['date'], 'xata': cx[c['idx']][0]['label'],
     'xata_id': cx[c['idx']][0]['id'], 'score': cx[c['idx']][1], 'sources': c['sources_flag']}
    for c in venn_cat['cat_xata']
  ],
  'catalog_only': [
    {'catalog': c['label'], 'date': c['date'], 'sources': c['sources_flag'],

    for c in venn_cat['cat_only']
```

    },
    {
        &#39;label&#39;: &#39;Trans-en-Provence 1981&#39;,
        &#39;ids&#39;: [&#39;rec_cobdg3tbjt595h637610&#39;,&#39;rec_cp1vddf6gfslia6urd30&#39;],
        &#39;note&#39;: &#39;Case page vs place/date naming&#39;,
    },
    {
        &#39;label&#39;: &#39;Tehran 1976&#39;,
        &#39;ids&#39;: [&#39;rec_cobdg3tbjt595h63766g&#39;,&#39;rec_cp1vddb4f9p514bqa5g0&#39;],
        &#39;note&#39;: &#39;Incident title vs city/date title&#39;,
    },
]

# False-positive fuzzy pairs to exclude from redundancy claims
FALSE_POS = [
    (&#39;Apollo 11&#39;, &#39;Apollo 14&#39;),
    (&#39;Disclosure Project Witness Panel&#39;, &#39;Disclosure Press Conference&#39;),  # 2021 vs 2001 — related program, different events
]

ALIASES = [
    ([&#39;roswell&#39;],[&#39;roswell&#39;]), ([&#39;kenneth arnold&#39;,&#39;arnold&#39;],[&#39;kenneth arnold&#39;,&#39;arnold&#39;]),
    ([&#39;battle los angeles&#39;,&#39;battle la&#39;],[&#39;battle los angeles&#39;,&#39;los angeles&#39;]),
    ([&#39;phoenix&#39;],[&#39;phoenix&#39;]), ([&#39;nimitz&#39;,&#39;tic tac&#39;],[&#39;nimitz&#39;,&#39;tic tac&#39;,&#39;fravor&#39;]),
    ([&#39;mcminnville&#39;,&#39;trent&#39;],[&#39;mcminnville&#39;,&#39;trent&#39;]), ([&#39;rendlesham&#39;],[&#39;rendlesham&#39;]),
    ([&#39;ariel&#39;,&#39;ruwa&#39;,&#39;zimbabwe&#39;],[&#39;ariel&#39;,&#39;ruwa&#39;,&#39;zimbabwe&#39;]), ([&#39;westall&#39;],[&#39;westall&#39;]),
    ([&#39;varginha&#39;],[&#39;varginha&#39;]), ([&#39;foo fighter&#39;],[&#39;foo fighter&#39;]), ([&#39;ghost rocket&#39;],[&#39;ghost rocket&#39;]),
    ([&#39;oumuamua&#39;,&#39;omuamua&#39;],[&#39;oumuamua&#39;,&#39;omuamua&#39;]), ([&#39;ohare&#39;,&#39;o hare&#39;],[&#39;ohare&#39;,&#39;o hare&#39;]),
    ([&#39;socorro&#39;,&#39;zamora&#39;],[&#39;socorro&#39;,&#39;zamora&#39;]), ([&#39;belgium&#39;,&#39;belgian&#39;],[&#39;belgium&#39;,&#39;belgian&#39;]),
    ([&#39;mainbrace&#39;],[&#39;mainbrace&#39;]), ([&#39;mantell&#39;],[&#39;mantell&#39;]), ([&#39;malmstrom&#39;],[&#39;malmstrom&#39;]),
    ([&#39;area 51&#39;],[&#39;area 51&#39;]), ([&#39;blue book&#39;],[&#39;blue book&#39;]), ([&#39;project sign&#39;],[&#39;project sign&#39;]),
    ([&#39;project grudge&#39;],[&#39;project grudge&#39;]), ([&#39;sputnik&#39;],[&#39;sputnik&#39;]), ([&#39;condon&#39;],[&#39;condon&#39;]),
    ([&#39;robertson&#39;],[&#39;robertson&#39;]), ([&#39;aatip&#39;],[&#39;aatip&#39;]),
    ([&#39;gimbal&#39;,&#39;gofast&#39;,&#39;go fast&#39;],[&#39;gimbal&#39;,&#39;gofast&#39;,&#39;go fast&#39;,&#39;theodore roosevelt&#39;]),
    ([&#39;florence&#39;,&#39;fiorentina&#39;],[&#39;florence&#39;,&#39;italy&#39;,&#39;franchi&#39;]), ([&#39;war worlds&#39;,&#39;orson&#39;],[&#39;war worlds&#39;,&#39;orson&#39;,&#39;welles&#39;]),
    ([&#39;carter&#39;],[&#39;carter&#39;]), ([&#39;reagan&#39;],[&#39;reagan&#39;]), ([&#39;trinity&#39;],[&#39;trinity&#39;]),
    ([&#39;gorman&#39;],[&#39;gorman&#39;]), ([&#39;tehran&#39;],[&#39;tehran&#39;]), ([&#39;trans en provence&#39;],[&#39;trans en provence&#39;]),
    ([&#39;chiles whitted&#39;],[&#39;chiles whitted&#39;]), ([&#39;nash fortenberry&#39;],[&#39;nash fortenberry&#39;]),
    ([&#39;alderney&#39;],[&#39;alderney&#39;]), ([&#39;racetrack&#39;],[&#39;racetrack&#39;]),
]

def alias_hit(a,b):
    for L,R in ALIASES:
        if any(x in a for x in L) and any(x in b for x in R):
            return True
    return False

def score_pair(a_norms, a_years, b_norm, b_years):
    best=0
    for an in a_norms:
        ratio=SequenceMatcher(None, an, b_norm).ratio()
        ta,tb=set(an.split()), set(b_norm.split())
        jacc=len(ta&amp;tb)/len(ta|tb) if ta and tb else 0
        s=max(ratio,jacc)
        shared={x for x in ta&amp;tb if len(x)&gt;=4}
        s += 0.1*min(len(shared),3)
        if alias_hit(an, b_norm): s += 0.35
        best=max(best,s)
    if a_years and b_years:
        if not (a_years &amp; b_years) and not any(abs(x-y)&lt;=5 for x in a_years for y in b_years):
            if best &lt; 0.95: return 0
    return best

# Prep catalog + neon for matching
def neon_label(r): return (r.get(&#39;name&#39;) or r.get(&#39;title&#39;) or &#39;&#39;).strip()

neon_e=[]
for i,r in enumerate(neon):
    lab=neon_label(r)
    neon_e.append({
        &#39;idx&#39;:i,&#39;id&#39;:r[&#39;id&#39;],&#39;label&#39;:lab,&#39;norm&#39;:normalize(lab),
        &#39;date&#39;:(r.get(&#39;date&#39;) or &#39;&#39;)[:10],&#39;year&#39;:year_from_iso(r.get(&#39;date&#39;)),
        &#39;years&#39;:years(lab)|({year_from_iso(r.get(&#39;date&#39;))} if year_from_iso(r.get(&#39;date&#39;)) else set()),
        &#39;location&#39;:r.get(&#39;location&#39;) or &#39;&#39;,&#39;description&#39;:(r.get(&#39;description&#39;) or &#39;&#39;)[:240],
    })

cat_e=[]
for i,c in enumerate(catalog):
    names=[c.get(&#39;canonical_name&#39;,&#39;&#39;)]+list(c.get(&#39;aliases&#39;) or [])
    lab=c.get(&#39;canonical_name&#39;,&#39;&#39;)
    d=c.get(&#39;date&#39;) or c.get(&#39;date_incident&#39;) or &#39;&#39;
    cat_e.append({
        &#39;idx&#39;:i,&#39;label&#39;:lab,&#39;norms&#39;:[normalize(n) for n in names if n],
        &#39;norm&#39;:normalize(lab),&#39;date&#39;:d,
        &#39;years&#39;:years(d+&#39; &#39;+&#39; &#39;.join(names)),
        &#39;sources&#39;:&#39;+&#39;.join(c.get(&#39;sources&#39;) or []),&#39;url&#39;:c.get(&#39;primary_url&#39;),
        &#39;claim&#39;:(c.get(&#39;claim&#39;) or &#39;&#39;)[:180],&#39;description&#39;:(c.get(&#39;description&#39;) or &#39;&#39;)[:240],
        &#39;raw&#39;:c,
    })

used=set(); cat_neon=[]
for c in cat_e:
    best=None
    for e in neon_e:
        if e[&#39;idx&#39;] in used: continue
        s=score_pair(c[&#39;norms&#39;], c[&#39;years&#39;], e[&#39;norm&#39;], e[&#39;years&#39;])
        if best is None or s&gt;best[0]: best=(s,e)
    if best and best[0]&gt;=0.58:
        used.add(best[1][&#39;idx&#39;])
        cat_neon.append((c,best[1],round(best[0],3)))

matched_cat={c[&#39;idx&#39;] for c,_,_ in cat_neon}
catalog_only=[c for c in cat_e if c[&#39;idx&#39;] not in matched_cat]

INST=[&#39;project&#39;,&#39;hearing&#39;,&#39;pentagon&#39;,&#39;nasa&#39;,&#39;aaro&#39;,&#39;aatip&#39;,&#39;ndaa&#39;,&#39;condon&#39;,&#39;robertson&#39;,&#39;majestic&#39;,&#39;national security&#39;,&#39;sputnik&#39;,&#39;area 51&#39;,&#39;mufon&#39;,&#39;assessment&#39;,&#39;defense&#39;,&#39;united nation&#39;,&#39;blue book&#39;,&#39;geipan&#39;,&#39;sky canada&#39;,&#39;war of the worlds&#39;,&#39;atomic&#39;,&#39;hiroshima&#39;,&#39;eisenhower&#39;,&#39;moon landing&#39;,&#39;avro&#39;,&#39;flying saucer&#39;,&#39;un &#39;]
def is_inst(n):
    n=n.lower(); return any(k in n for k in INST)

# Suspicious matches
suspicious=[]
for c,e,s in cat_neon:
    if &#39;Trinity: The First Atomic&#39; in c[&#39;label&#39;] and &#39;Trinity&#39; in e[&#39;label&#39;]:
        suspicious.append({&#39;catalog&#39;:c[&#39;label&#39;],&#39;neon&#39;:e[&#39;label&#39;],&#39;reason&#39;:&#39;atomic test vs Trinity UFO crash case&#39;,&#39;score&#39;:s})

# Enrich semantic clusters with names from neon
clusters=[]
redundant_ids=set()
for cl in SEMANTIC_CLUSTERS:
    members=[]
    for iid in cl[&#39;ids&#39;]:
        r=neon_by.get(iid) or xata.get(iid)
        if not r: continue
        members.append({&#39;id&#39;:iid,&#39;name&#39;:neon_label(r) if iid in neon_by else r.get(&#39;name&#39;),&#39;date&#39;:(r.get(&#39;date&#39;) or &#39;&#39;)[:10]})
        redundant_ids.add(iid)
    clusters.append({**cl,&#39;members&#39;:members,&#39;count&#39;:len(members)})

# Effective unique events in Neon after collapsing clusters
# each cluster collapses to 1, non-cluster ids remain
clustered = redundant_ids
unique_after = len(neon) - sum(c[&#39;count&#39;]-1 for c in clusters)

# Era
neon_era=Counter(era(year_from_iso(r.get(&#39;date&#39;))) for r in neon)
cat_era=Counter(era(min(c[&#39;years&#39;]) if c[&#39;years&#39;] else None) for c in cat_e)

# Field richness on Neon
fill={
  &#39;with_location&#39;: sum(1 for r in neon if r.get(&#39;location&#39;)),
  &#39;with_latlon&#39;: sum(1 for r in neon if r.get(&#39;latitude&#39;) is not None and r.get(&#39;longitude&#39;) is not None),
  &#39;with_description&#39;: sum(1 for r in neon if r.get(&#39;description&#39;)),
  &#39;with_photos&#39;: sum(1 for r in neon if r.get(&#39;photos&#39;)),
  &#39;with_summary&#39;: sum(1 for r in neon if r.get(&#39;summary&#39;)),
  &#39;with_title&#39;: sum(1 for r in neon if r.get(&#39;title&#39;)),
}
cat_fill={
  &#39;with_claim&#39;: sum(1 for c in catalog if c.get(&#39;claim&#39;)),
  &#39;with_photo&#39;: sum(1 for c in catalog if c.get(&#39;photo_src&#39;)),
  &#39;with_timeline_url&#39;: sum(1 for c in catalog if c.get(&#39;timeline_url&#39;)),
  &#39;with_incident_url&#39;: sum(1 for c in catalog if c.get(&#39;incident_url&#39;)),
  &#39;both_sources&#39;: sum(1 for c in catalog if set(c.get(&#39;sources&#39;) or [])=={&#39;timeline&#39;,&#39;incident&#39;}),
}

report={
  &#39;meta&#39;:{
    &#39;compared_at&#39;: datetime.now().isoformat(timespec=&#39;seconds&#39;),
    &#39;verdict&#39;: &#39;Xata CSV and Neon events are the same spine (141 shared IDs). The CSV is an exact 2× export duplicate plus a header-echo row. Neon adds one MJ-12 briefing record not in the CSV. The UFO DB catalog is a different product: only ~31 famous-case overlaps; 69 rows (esp. institutional/modern disclosure) are absent from both databases.&#39;,
    &#39;counts&#39;:{
      &#39;xata_csv_raw_rows&#39;: len(xata_raw),
      &#39;xata_header_echo_rows&#39;: header_echo,
      &#39;xata_exact_duplicate_extra_rows&#39;: exact_dup_extra,
      &#39;xata_clean_unique_ids&#39;: len(xata),
      &#39;neon_rows&#39;: len(neon),
      &#39;catalog_rows&#39;: len(catalog),
      &#39;shared_ids&#39;: len(shared),
      &#39;xata_only_real&#39;: len(x_only),
      &#39;neon_only&#39;: len(n_only),
      &#39;catalog_matched_neon&#39;: len(cat_neon),
      &#39;catalog_only&#39;: len(catalog_only),
      &#39;catalog_only_institutional&#39;: sum(1 for c in catalog_only if is_inst(c[&#39;label&#39;])),
      &#39;catalog_only_other&#39;: sum(1 for c in catalog_only if not is_inst(c[&#39;label&#39;])),
      &#39;semantic_duplicate_clusters&#39;: len(clusters),
      &#39;ids_in_semantic_clusters&#39;: len(clustered),
      &#39;neon_effective_unique_after_cluster_collapse&#39;: unique_after,
    },
    &#39;eras&#39;:{&#39;neon&#39;:dict(neon_era),&#39;catalog&#39;:dict(cat_era)},
    &#39;field_richness&#39;:{&#39;neon&#39;:fill,&#39;catalog&#39;:cat_fill},
  },
  &#39;neon_only_records&#39;:[
    {&#39;id&#39;:i,&#39;name&#39;:neon_label(neon_by[i]),&#39;date&#39;:(neon_by[i].get(&#39;date&#39;) or &#39;&#39;)[:10],
     &#39;location&#39;:neon_by[i].get(&#39;location&#39;),&#39;description&#39;:(neon_by[i].get(&#39;description&#39;) or &#39;&#39;)[:300]}
    for i in sorted(n_only)
  ],
  &#39;semantic_duplicate_clusters&#39;: clusters,
  &#39;catalog_matches&#39;:[
    {&#39;score&#39;:s,&#39;catalog&#39;:c[&#39;label&#39;],&#39;catalog_date&#39;:c[&#39;date&#39;],&#39;catalog_sources&#39;:c[&#39;sources&#39;],
     &#39;neon_id&#39;:e[&#39;id&#39;],&#39;neon_name&#39;:e[&#39;label&#39;],&#39;neon_date&#39;:e[&#39;date&#39;]}
    for c,e,s in sorted(cat_neon, key=lambda x:-x[2])
  ],
  &#39;suspicious_matches&#39;: suspicious,
  &#39;catalog_only&#39;:[
    {&#39;name&#39;:c[&#39;label&#39;],&#39;date&#39;:c[&#39;date&#39;],&#39;sources&#39;:c[&#39;sources&#39;],&#39;institutional&#39;:is_inst(c[&#39;label&#39;]),
     &#39;url&#39;:c[&#39;url&#39;],&#39;claim&#39;:c[&#39;claim&#39;]}

(ROOT/&#39;three-way-comparison.json&#39;).write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding=&#39;utf-8&#39;)

# Markdown
m=report[&#39;meta&#39;]; cnt=m[&#39;counts&#39;]
lines=[
&#39;# Three-Way Events Comparison&#39;,
&#39;&#39;,
f&#34;**Compared:** {m[&#39;compared_at&#39;]}&#34;,
&#39;&#39;,
&#39;## Verdict&#39;,
&#39;&#39;,
m[&#39;verdict&#39;],
&#39;&#39;,

&#39;&#39;,
&#39;| Dataset | Rows | Notes |&#39;,
&#39;|---|---:|---|&#39;,
f&#34;| Xata `events.csv` | {cnt[&#39;xata_csv_raw_rows&#39;]} raw → **{cnt[&#39;xata_clean_unique_ids&#39;]} clean** | {cnt[&#39;xata_exact_duplicate_extra_rows&#39;]} exact ID-dup extras + {cnt[&#39;xata_header_echo_rows&#39;]} header-echo junk row |&#34;,
f&#34;| Neon `events` | **{cnt[&#39;neon_rows&#39;]}** | Live DB |&#34;,

&#39;&#39;,
&#39;## Gaps&#39;,
&#39;&#39;,
&#39;### 1. Xata CSV ↔ Neon (identity)&#39;,
&#39;&#39;,
f&#34;- Shared IDs: **{cnt[&#39;shared_ids&#39;]}** (content-identical spine)&#34;,
f&#34;- Real Xata-only IDs: **{cnt[&#39;xata_only_real&#39;]}**&#34;,
f&#34;- Neon-only IDs: **{cnt[&#39;neon_only&#39;]}** — MJ-12 Eisenhower briefing (`rec_ct37o77rkv8v7ahcv2gg`)&#34;,
&#39;&#39;,
&#39;**Conclusion:** Neon is not a half-migration. After cleaning the CSV, Neon ⊇ Xata export, plus one extra record.&#39;,
&#39;&#39;,
&#39;### 2. UFO DB catalog ↔ Neon/Xata&#39;,
&#39;&#39;,
f&#34;- Matched to Neon (fuzzy name/date): **{cnt[&#39;catalog_matched_neon&#39;]} / {cnt[&#39;catalog_rows&#39;]}** ({cnt[&#39;catalog_matched_neon&#39;]/cnt[&#39;catalog_rows&#39;]*100:.0f}%)&#34;,
f&#34;- Catalog-only: **{cnt[&#39;catalog_only&#39;]}**&#34;,
f&#34;  - Institutional / modern disclosure spine: **{cnt[&#39;catalog_only_institutional&#39;]}**&#34;,
f&#34;  - Cases / other not in DB: **{cnt[&#39;catalog_only_other&#39;]}**&#34;,
&#39;&#39;,

&#39;&#39;,

&#39;&#39;,
]
for s in suspicious:
    lines.append(f&#34;- Catalog **{s[&#39;catalog&#39;]}** ↔ Neon **{s[&#39;neon&#39;]}** — {s[&#39;reason&#39;]}&#34;)

lines += [
&#39;&#39;,
